onChange.script:
# backlog 3.3: several terminals can be open on ONE die cast machine, and a
	# peer's Open / Release / Void / shift-output write is invisible here until
	# something re-reads. now(ms) is Perspective's only timer, so a 20 s tick
	# drives the SAME refreshToken the Refresh button and every mutation already
	# bump -- no existing binding had to change. Cost: the ~9 refreshToken-keyed
	# runScript bindings on this view re-run once per tick per open terminal.
	# The computed breakdown is deliberately NOT auto-recomputed (that would
	# wipe an operator's half-typed scrap). Gross shots are ADDITIVE, so each
	# terminal's entry is its own increment -- a peer's write cannot make this
	# preview double-count, and no submit-time staleness guard is needed.
	self.view.custom.refreshToken = (self.view.custom.refreshToken or 0) + 1

if self.view.custom.selectedShiftId is None:
		self.view.custom.selectedShiftId = self.view.custom.defaultShiftId

import java.lang
	# The script module can only be handed SCALARS (a container prop crossing a
	# runScript arg comes back as an unusable ImmutableList on re-eval), so the
	# container pieces are overlaid here, where self.view is in scope:
	#   itemOptions         - one shared fetch for the whole grid
	#   bulkOpenDraft       - the operator's retained entries
	#   bulkOpenResult      - the last submission's per-row outcome
	#   openBasketInstances - the Release / Void half of the merged tab
	# Open Baskets and Currently Open were two views of the SAME cavities split
	# by whether a basket exists (spec 6.1); this is the join that ends that.
	_u = BlueRidge.Common.Util.extractQualifiedValues
	rows = _u(value) or []
	opts = _u(self.view.custom.itemOptions) or []
	draft = _u(self.view.custom.bulkOpenDraft) or {}
	results = _u(self.view.custom.bulkOpenResult) or {}
	byCavity = {}
	for o in (_u(self.view.custom.openBasketInstances) or []):
		o = o or {}
		byCavity["%s" % o.get("toolCavityId")] = o
	out = []
	for r in rows:
		r = dict(r or {})
		key = "%s" % r.get("toolCavityId")
		r["itemOptions"] = opts
		if not r.get("alreadyOpen"):
			# ONLY what the OPERATOR entered. The cavity CONFIGURED part rides
			# the row as configuredItemId and the row displays it; copying it
			# in here made every untouched row look like a staged submission.
			d = draft.get(key) or {}
			r["itemId"] = d.get("itemId")
			r["scannedLtt"] = d.get("scannedLtt") or ""
		res = results.get(key) or {}
		r["resultState"] = res.get("state") or ""
		r["resultMessage"] = res.get("message") or ""
		o = byCavity.get(key) or {}
		r["lotId"] = o.get("lotId")
		r["lotName"] = o.get("lotName") or r.get("openLotName") or ""
		r["pieceCount"] = o.get("pieceCount") or r.get("openPieceCount") or 0
		r["maxPieceCount"] = o.get("maxPieceCount")
		r["belowStandard"] = bool(o.get("belowStandard"))
		r["contributorCount"] = o.get("contributorCount") or 0
		r["openedAtDisplay"] = o.get("openedAtDisplay") or ""
		r["voidEligible"] = bool(o.get("voidEligible"))
		r["rowKind"] = "cavity"
		out.append(r)
	# The footer counts are a fold over exactly these rows, and they change
	# only when these rows change -- so they are computed here rather than in
	# a second pass nothing would trigger. lotFooter feeds no binding this
	# transform reads, so the write cannot loop.
	running = 0
	pieces = 0
	for r in out:
		if r.get("alreadyOpen"):
			running += 1
			pieces += BlueRidge.Common.Util.toIntOrNone(r.get("pieceCount")) or 0
	try:
		self.view.custom.lotFooter = {"running": running, "pieces": pieces,
			"empty": len(out) - running}
	except (Exception, java.lang.Exception):
		# Cosmetic only -- the footer counts must never take the grid down.
		pass
	return self.view.rootContainer.groupByPart(out)

transforms.code:
import java.lang
	_u = BlueRidge.Common.Util.extractQualifiedValues
	base = BlueRidge.Workorder.DieCast.mapBreakdownInstances(value) or []
	raw = _u(value) or []
	# One shared defect-code fetch for the whole list: the row view used to run
	# its own binding, i.e. one identical query PER CAVITY. Fetched DIRECTLY
	# rather than read off a sibling view property -- reaching across from
	# inside a props.instances transform takes the WHOLE repeater down if that
	# property is ever missing, which is what a partial deploy did on prod
	# (2026-09-10).
	opts = BlueRidge.Quality.DefectCode.getForDropdown("DieCast") or []
	try:
		# Workorder.DieCastVarianceReason (D15). Guarded because a gateway that
		# has the views but not yet the named query must still render the grid.
		reasons = BlueRidge.Workorder.DieCast.listVarianceReasons() or []
	except (Exception, java.lang.Exception):
		reasons = []
	fallbackDw = BlueRidge.Common.Util.toIntOrNone(self.view.custom.dieWideShots) or 0
	out = []
	for i, r in enumerate(base):
		r = dict(r or {})
		src = (_u(raw[i]) if i < len(raw) else {}) or {}
		pend = src.get("IsPending")
		r["isPending"] = bool(pend) if pend is not None else (r.get("lotId") is None)
		r["priorScrapThisShift"] = src.get("PriorScrapThisShift") or 0
		dw = src.get("DieWideShots")
		r["dieWideShots"] = dw if dw is not None else fallbackDw
		r["defectOptions"] = opts
		r["varianceReasonOptions"] = reasons
		# An OPAQUE per-consumer routing token for the ScrapLineRow children.
		# lotId alone was ambiguous: every basketless cavity carries None.
		r["ownerKey"] = "cav:%s" % r.get("toolCavityId")
		r["rowKind"] = "cavity"
		out.append(r)
	return self.view.rootContainer.groupByPart(out)

# Gate at the door (decision 1, 2026-09-14): the popup opens only
	# inside an elevation window. requireElevation stashes the intent and
	# opens ElevationModal; the dieMountRequested handler below re-enters
	# here with the window now open.
	if BlueRidge.Common.Session.isElevated(self.session):
		system.perspective.openPopup("mpp-die-mount",
			"BlueRidge/Components/Popups/DieMount",
			params={"cellLocationId": self.session.custom.cell.locationId,
				"popupId": "mpp-die-mount",
				"replyMessage": "dieMountResult"},
			modal=True, showCloseIcon=True)
		return
	BlueRidge.Common.Session.requireElevation(
		self.session, "DieMount", "Die Mount", {"intent": "open"})

customMethods.name: applyCell
customMethods.script:
cellId = BlueRidge.Common.Util.extractQualifiedValues(cellId)
	row = BlueRidge.Location.Location.findCellById(self.view.custom.cells, cellId)
	if row is None:
		return
	prev = BlueRidge.Common.Util.extractQualifiedValues(self.session.custom.cell) or {}
	if prev.get("locationId") == row.get("value"):
		return
	self.session.custom.cell = {"locationId": row.get("value"), "code": row.get("code") or "", "name": row.get("name") or ""}
	# Everything below belongs to the PREVIOUS die. The bound props
	# (activeTool, shotStatus, itemOptions, openBasketInstances) key off
	# session.custom.cell and re-read themselves; this imperative state does
	# not, and Submit builds its lines from view.custom.breakdown -- so
	# leaving it would let an operator submit the old die's cavities against
	# the new press.
	self.view.custom.breakdown = []
	self.view.custom.breakdownEntries = {}
	self.view.custom.counterReading = ""
	self.view.custom.pendingSubmit = ""
	self.view.custom.bulkOpenDraft = {}
	self.view.custom.bulkOpenResult = {}
	self.view.custom.bulkOpenPendingCount = 0
	self.view.custom.pendingReleaseLotId = None
	self.view.custom.pendingReleaseLotName = ""
	self.view.custom.pendingVoidLotId = None
	self.view.custom.pendingVoidLotName = ""
	# die-wide shot counts are per-die; re-seed the named rows at zero
	self.view.custom.dieWideLines = []
	self.view.custom.dieWideShots = 0
	self.seedDieWide()
	# defaultEntryShiftId is CELL-scoped, so the reporting shift is re-seeded
	# rather than carried across.
	self.view.custom.selectedShiftId = BlueRidge.Oee.Shift.defaultEntryShiftId(row.get("value"))
	# force the runScript bindings to re-read even where their other
	# arguments are unchanged (runScript caches on its arguments)
	self.view.custom.refreshToken = (self.view.custom.refreshToken or 0) + 1
	self.recomputeTotals()

customMethods.name: startup
customMethods.script:
# Operator gate: no logged-in operator -> open the initials popup OVER this
	# screen. Non-blocking: the page still populates behind the modal, and
	# session.custom is reactive, so the operator label/mutations pick up the
	# user with no re-populate.
	if not self.session.custom.appUserId:
		system.perspective.openPopup("mpp-initials", "BlueRidge/Components/Popups/InitialsEntry", params={"popupId": "mpp-initials"}, modal=True, showCloseIcon=False, overlayDismiss=False)
	# backlog 2.1: pre-select the reporting shift with the CURRENT shift. The
	# custom.defaultShiftId binding also seeds it through its onChange, but that
	# only fires once the binding produces a value -- seeding here makes the
	# first paint deterministic instead of racing the binding.
	if self.view.custom.selectedShiftId is None:
		self.view.custom.selectedShiftId = BlueRidge.Oee.Shift.defaultEntryShiftId(self.session.custom.cell.locationId)
	self.seedDieWide()
	self.recomputeTotals()

customMethods.name: submitBulkOpen
copyPartToEmptyRows
customMethods.script:
# Convenience for a SINGLE-part die: take the first part the operator has
	# already picked and put it on every other cavity that has none yet. This is
	# deliberately NOT an auto-assign -- it only ever runs on an explicit press,
	# and every row's dropdown stays editable afterwards. On a family die (a
	# different part per cavity) the operator simply never presses it.
	draft = BlueRidge.Common.Util.extractQualifiedValues(self.view.custom.bulkOpenDraft) or {}
	cavities = BlueRidge.Common.Util.extractQualifiedValues(self.view.custom.cavityOptions) or []
	openInstances = BlueRidge.Common.Util.extractQualifiedValues(self.view.custom.openBasketInstances) or []
	taken = {}
	for o in openInstances:
		taken["%s" % (o or {}).get("toolCavityId")] = True
	source = None
	for c in cavities:
		d = draft.get("%s" % (c or {}).get("value")) or {}
		if d.get("itemId") is not None:
			source = d.get("itemId")
			break
	if source is None:
		BlueRidge.Common.Notify.toast("Pick a part first", "Select the part on one cavity row, then press this to copy it to the empty rows.", "warning")
		return
	out = dict(draft)
	copied = 0
	for c in cavities:
		cavityId = (c or {}).get("value")
		key = "%s" % cavityId
		if taken.get(key):
			continue
		d = dict(out.get(key) or {})
		if d.get("itemId") is not None:
			continue
		d["toolCavityId"] = cavityId
		d["itemId"] = source
		d["scannedLtt"] = d.get("scannedLtt") or ""
		out[key] = d
		copied += 1
	self.view.custom.bulkOpenDraft = out
	self.view.custom.refreshToken = (self.view.custom.refreshToken or 0) + 1
	BlueRidge.Common.Notify.toast("Part copied", "Applied to %s empty cavity row(s)." % copied, "info")

customMethods.name: clearBulkOpen
computeBreakdown
recomputeTotals
customMethods.script:
import java.lang
	# The totals ARE the equation (spec 6.3):
	#     Shots - Good - Scrap = Unaccounted,   plus a separate Pending.
	# Shots is RAW and die-wide is charged to Scrap, so raw = net + die-wide
	# balances without double counting. Cavities with NO basket sit OUTSIDE
	# the identity (3.5): their shots are Pending, never Unaccounted.
	# Preview arithmetic only -- DieCastShiftOutput_Record is authoritative.
	_u = BlueRidge.Common.Util.extractQualifiedValues
	rows = _u(self.view.custom.breakdown) or []
	entries = _u(self.view.custom.breakdownEntries) or {}
	dw = BlueRidge.Common.Util.toIntOrNone(self.view.custom.dieWideShots) or 0
	try:
		reasons = BlueRidge.Workorder.DieCast.listVarianceReasons() or []
	except (Exception, java.lang.Exception):
		reasons = []
	needsNote = {}
	for o in reasons:
		o = o or {}
		needsNote["%s" % o.get("value")] = bool(o.get("requiresNote"))
	shots = 0
	netsSeen = {}
	accounted = 0
	unacc = 0
	offNames = []
	needNames = []
	good = 0
	scrap = 0
	pendingShots = 0
	need = 0
	active = 0
	for r in rows:
		r = r or {}
		if ("%s" % (r.get("CavityStatusCode") or "Active")) == "Active":
			active += 1
		# toolCavityId:lotId -- one cavity can have two rows (a basket
		# released earlier this shift, plus a newly opened one).
		e = _u(entries.get("%s:%s" % (r.get("ToolCavityId"), r.get("LotId")))) or {}
		s = 0
		for sl in (_u(e.get("scrapLines")) or []):
			sl = sl or {}
			q = BlueRidge.Common.Util.toIntOrNone(sl.get("quantity"))
			if sl.get("defectCodeId") is not None and q:
				s += q
		scrap += s
		newShots = BlueRidge.Common.Util.toIntOrNone(r.get("NewShots")) or 0
		isPending = r.get("IsPending")
		if isPending is None:
			isPending = (r.get("LotId") is None)
		if isPending:
			pendingShots += newShots
			continue
		if not r.get("IsOpen"):
			# released earlier this shift: scrap only, no shots left to account
			continue
		rowDw = BlueRidge.Common.Util.toIntOrNone(r.get("DieWideShots"))
		if rowDw is None:
			rowDw = dw
		net = newShots - rowDw
		if net < 0:
			net = 0
		g = BlueRidge.Common.Util.toIntOrNone(e.get("good"))
		if g is None:
			g = BlueRidge.Common.Util.toIntOrNone(r.get("ProposedGood")) or 0
		# PARTS counts NET, which is what the row's SHOTS cell shows, so the
		# total is the sum of the column above it. Die-wide is already out
		# of net and is reported as its own term, not folded into SCRAP.
		shots += net
		netsSeen[net] = 1
		accounted += 1
		good += g
		v = net - g - s
		unacc += v
		if v != 0:
			nm = ("%s" % (r.get("CavityDescription") or "")).strip()
			if not nm:
				nm = "Cavity %s" % (r.get("CavityCode") or "?")
			offNames.append(nm)
			rid = e.get("varianceReasonId")
			note = ("%s" % (e.get("varianceNote") or "")).strip()
			if rid is None or (needsNote.get("%s" % rid) and not note):
				need += 1
				needNames.append(nm)
	# Die-wide is ALREADY out of every cavity's net, so adding it to
	# SCRAP here would double-count it and stop SCRAP being the sum of
	# the CAVITY SCRAP column. It is reported as its own term instead.
	# The WRITE is unchanged -- DieCastShiftOutput_Record still fans it
	# out across active cavities as real RejectEvents (D8).
	dieWideParts = dw * accounted
	# Name them. Counting them still leaves the operator scanning rows.
	msg = ""
	if needNames:
		shown = needNames[:3]
		tail = "" if len(needNames) <= 3 else " and %d more" % (len(needNames) - 3)
		msg = "Needs a reason: " + ", ".join(shown) + tail
	# 3.7: the gate is on DISPOSITIONS, never on the numbers. The operator is
	# never asked to make the numbers agree, only to say what happened -- and
	# Unknown always discharges that. A clean shift never sees the gate.
	# One press cycle fires every cavity, so the summed figure is PARTS, not
	# shots. State the shots it came from -- but only when a single figure is
	# actually true of every accounted cavity.
	reading = BlueRidge.Common.Util.toIntOrNone(self.view.custom.counterReading) or 0
	if len(netsSeen) == 1 and accounted > 0:
		per = list(netsSeen.keys())[0]
		shotsNote = "{:,} shots x {} cavities".format(per, accounted)
	elif reading > 0:
		shotsNote = "from counter {:,}".format(reading)
	else:
		shotsNote = ""
	# UNACCOUNTED is the SUM OF THE VARIANCE COLUMN, not a residual of the
	# other three totals -- so it agrees with the rows even when a cavity
	# is excluded from the identity.
	if offNames:
		shownO = offNames[:3]
		tailO = "" if len(offNames) <= 3 else " +%d more" % (len(offNames) - 3)
		unaccNote = ", ".join(shownO) + tailO
	else:
		unaccNote = ""
	self.view.custom.reconcile = {
		"shotsNote": shotsNote, "unaccountedNote": unaccNote,
		"dieWide": dieWideParts,
		"shots": shots, "good": good, "scrap": scrap,
		"unaccounted": unacc, "pending": pendingShots,
		"needCount": need, "gateMessage": msg,
		"canSubmit": bool(need == 0 and len(rows) > 0)}

customMethods.name: groupByPart
customMethods.script:
# A cavity LETTER is unique per (Tool, Item, CavityCode), not per tool: a
	# family die repeats a / b / c once per part. Prod's DM0124 is 11 cavities
	# = 3 letters x 4 parts, and one part has no 'a' -- ungrouped that reads as
	# duplicate cavities with no explanation. Shared by BOTH grids.
	# A group instance carries ONLY rowKind / groupLabel / groupDetail; every
	# other param falls back to the row view's own declared default.
	rows = rows or []
	groups = {}
	order = []
	for r in rows:
		p = (r or {}).get("configuredPart") or ""
		if not p:
			p = "(no part configured)"
		if p not in groups:
			groups[p] = []
			order.append(p)
		groups[p].append(r)
	order.sort()
	out = []
	# One part on the die: a band on every screen would say the same thing.
	banded = len(order) > 1
	for p in order:
		items = sorted(groups[p], key=lambda x: "%s" % ((x or {}).get("cavityCode") or ""))
		if banded:
			out.append({"rowKind": "group", "groupLabel": p,
				"groupDetail": "%s cavities" % len(items)})
		out.extend(items)
	return out

customMethods.name: seedDieWide
customMethods.script:
# D7: the die-wide block carries EXPLICIT NAMED ROWS for Warm-up (999)
	# and Quality test (008) -- they are what actually happens every shift, and
	# a bare 'add a reason' row is how they stopped being recorded. Resolved by
	# CODE off the Die Cast defect list, whose label is "CODE - Description"
	# (Quality.DefectCode.getForDropdown). A code that is not seeded in this
	# environment still gets its row, with the reason left for the operator.
	if BlueRidge.Common.Util.extractQualifiedValues(self.view.custom.dieWideLines):
		return
	opts = BlueRidge.Quality.DefectCode.getForDropdown("DieCast") or []
	def _byCode(code):
		for o in opts:
			lbl = "%s" % ((o or {}).get("label") or "")
			if lbl == code or lbl.startswith(code + " -"):
				return (o or {}).get("value")
		return None
	self.view.custom.dieWideLines = [
		{"rowLabel": "Warm-up shots", "code": "999",
			"defectCodeId": _byCode("999"), "shots": 0, "fixed": True},
		{"rowLabel": "Quality test shots", "code": "008",
			"defectCodeId": _byCode("008"), "shots": 0, "fixed": True},
	]
	self.view.custom.dieWideSeed = (self.view.custom.dieWideSeed or 0) + 1
	self._recomputeDieWide()

customMethods.name: _recomputeDieWide
addDieWideLine
customMethods.script:
rows = BlueRidge.Common.Util.extractQualifiedValues(self.view.custom.dieWideLines) or []
	rows = [dict(r or {}) for r in rows]
	rows.append({"rowLabel": "", "code": "", "defectCodeId": None,
		"shots": 0, "fixed": False})
	self.view.custom.dieWideLines = rows
	self.view.custom.dieWideSeed = (self.view.custom.dieWideSeed or 0) + 1

customMethods.name: setDieWideLine
customMethods.script:
rows = BlueRidge.Common.Util.extractQualifiedValues(self.view.custom.dieWideLines) or []
	rows = [dict(r or {}) for r in rows]
	if index is None or index < 0 or index >= len(rows):
		return
	rows[index]["defectCodeId"] = defectCodeId
	rows[index]["shots"] = BlueRidge.Common.Util.toIntOrNone(shots) or 0
	self.view.custom.dieWideLines = rows
	self._recomputeDieWide()
	# 3.3: die-wide REDUCES the proposal rather than sitting beside it, so the
	# per-cavity proposals are stale the moment this changes. Quiet recompute:
	# it does NOT blank the breakdown first, so the operator's typed scrap and
	# hand-counted Good survive -- adding a warm-up row must not cost them
	# twelve cavities of entry.
	self.computeBreakdown(True)
	self.recomputeTotals()

customMethods.name: removeDieWideLine
customMethods.script:
rows = BlueRidge.Common.Util.extractQualifiedValues(self.view.custom.dieWideLines) or []
	rows = [dict(r or {}) for r in rows]
	if index is None or index < 0 or index >= len(rows):
		return
	if rows[index].get("fixed"):
		return
	del rows[index]
	self.view.custom.dieWideLines = rows
	self.view.custom.dieWideSeed = (self.view.custom.dieWideSeed or 0) + 1
	self._recomputeDieWide()
	self.computeBreakdown(True)
	self.recomputeTotals()

customMethods.name: submitShiftOutput
customMethods.script:
import java.lang
	_u = BlueRidge.Common.Util.extractQualifiedValues
	rows = _u(self.view.custom.breakdown) or []
	entries = _u(self.view.custom.breakdownEntries) or {}
	tool = _u(self.view.custom.activeTool) or {}
	cell = _u(self.session.custom.cell) or {}
	rec = _u(self.view.custom.reconcile) or {}
	shotLoss = self.dieWideShotLoss()
	if not rows:
		BlueRidge.Common.Notify.toast("Nothing to submit", "Enter the press counter reading and press Compute first.", "warning")
		return
	if not rec.get("canSubmit"):
		# Never "variance must be zero" -- say what is MISSING (3.7).
		BlueRidge.Common.Notify.toast("Say what happened first", rec.get("gateMessage") or "", "warning")
		return
	lines = []
	overflow = []
	for r in rows:
		r = r or {}
		tcid = r.get("ToolCavityId")
		# BUG FIX: the draft entry used to be keyed on "%s" % lotId, so EVERY
		# cavity without a basket collided on the string "None" and they all
		# shared one entry. ToolCavityId exists on every row, basket or not.
		e = _u(entries.get("%s:%s" % (tcid, r.get("LotId")))) or {}
		scrapLines = []
		for sl in (_u(e.get("scrapLines")) or []):
			sl = sl or {}
			d = sl.get("defectCodeId")
			q = BlueRidge.Common.Util.toIntOrNone(sl.get("quantity"))
			if d and q:
				scrapLines.append({"defectCodeId": d, "quantity": q})
		lotId = r.get("LotId")
		isPending = r.get("IsPending")
		if isPending is None:
			isPending = (lotId is None)
		if isPending or lotId is None:
			# A cavity with NO basket: pieceDelta MUST be 0 and toolCavityId is
			# REQUIRED. Its shots are PENDING -- they credit to the next basket,
			# because that is where the castings physically are (3.6) -- so the
			# line exists only to carry scrap, and writes no contribution row.
			if not scrapLines:
				continue
			lines.append({"lotId": None, "toolCavityId": tcid, "pieceDelta": 0,
				"scrapLines": scrapLines, "varianceReasonId": None,
				"varianceNote": None})
			continue
		if not r.get("IsOpen"):
			# BUG FIX: this row used to be SKIPPED outright -- which silently
			# discarded scrap on a basket released earlier in the shift and then
			# toasted "Shift output recorded". DieCastShiftOutput_Record v2.1 was
			# explicitly widened to accept exactly that case; the view threw it
			# away before the proc ever saw it. A closed basket takes scrap only,
			# so there is nothing left to credit and pieceDelta is 0.
			if not scrapLines:
				continue
			lines.append({"lotId": lotId, "toolCavityId": tcid, "pieceDelta": 0,
				"scrapLines": scrapLines, "varianceReasonId": None,
				"varianceNote": None})
			continue
		good = BlueRidge.Common.Util.toIntOrNone(e.get("good"))
		if good is None:
			good = BlueRidge.Common.Util.toIntOrNone(r.get("ProposedGood")) or 0
		note = e.get("varianceNote")
		if note is not None:
			note = ("%s" % note).strip() or None
		lines.append({"lotId": lotId, "toolCavityId": tcid, "pieceDelta": good,
			"scrapLines": scrapLines,
			"varianceReasonId": e.get("varianceReasonId"),
			"varianceNote": note})
		h = BlueRidge.Common.Util.toIntOrNone(r.get("MaxHeadroom"))
		if h is not None and h < 2147483647 and good > h:
			overflow.append({"lotId": lotId, "lotName": r.get("LotName") or "",
				"cavityCode": r.get("CavityCode") or "", "toolCavityId": tcid,
				"itemId": r.get("ItemId"), "headroom": h, "good": good,
				"remainder": good - h, "scrapLines": scrapLines})
	if not lines and not shotLoss:
		BlueRidge.Common.Notify.toast("Nothing to submit", "No cavity has anything to record.", "warning")
		return
	term = None
	try:
		term = self.session.custom.terminal.terminalLocationId
	except (Exception, java.lang.Exception):
		term = None
	if overflow:
		self.view.custom.pendingSubmit = system.util.jsonEncode({
			"counterReading": BlueRidge.Common.Util.toIntOrNone(self.view.custom.counterReading),
			"lines": lines, "overflow": overflow, "shotLoss": shotLoss,
			"shiftId": self.view.custom.selectedShiftId, "toolId": tool.get("ToolId"),
			"cellLocationId": cell.get("locationId"), "terminalLocationId": term})
		system.perspective.openPopup("mpp-diecast-overflow",
			"BlueRidge/Components/Popups/DieCastOverflow",
			params={"replyMessage": "dieCastOverflowResult", "popupId": "mpp-diecast-overflow", "overflow": overflow},
			modal=True, showCloseIcon=True)
		return
	data = {"shiftId": self.view.custom.selectedShiftId, "toolId": tool.get("ToolId"),
		"lines": lines, "shotLoss": shotLoss,
		"counterReading": BlueRidge.Common.Util.toIntOrNone(self.view.custom.counterReading),
		"cellLocationId": cell.get("locationId")}
	result = BlueRidge.Workorder.DieCast.recordShiftOutput(data, appUserId=self.session.custom.appUserId, terminalLocationId=term)
	BlueRidge.Common.Ui.notifyResult(result, successTitle="Shift reconciled")
	if result and result.get("Status"):
		self._afterSubmit()

		# D3/D5: the operator's counted Good and the closing scrap
		# batch, both collected by the release dialog. finalPieceDelta is
		# None when the counted figure still agrees with the derived one,
		# and the proc then runs its own counterReading-derived delta.
		"finalPieceDelta": finalPieceDelta,
		"scrapLines": scrapLines or [],
	}
	result = BlueRidge.Lots.Lot.releaseDieCast(data)
	BlueRidge.Common.Ui.notifyResult(result, successTitle="Basket released")

customMethods.name: resolveOverflow
customMethods.script:
raw = self.view.custom.pendingSubmit
	ps = system.util.jsonDecode(raw) if raw else None
	if not ps:
		return
	lines = ps.get("lines") or []
	shotLoss = ps.get("shotLoss") or []
	overflow = ps.get("overflow") or []
	shiftId = ps.get("shiftId")
	toolId = ps.get("toolId")
	cellId = ps.get("cellLocationId")
	term = ps.get("terminalLocationId")
	gross = ps.get("counterReading")
	appUserId = self.session.custom.appUserId
	if action == "cancel":
		self.view.custom.pendingSubmit = ""
		return
	decisions = BlueRidge.Common.Util.extractQualifiedValues(decisions) or {}
	def _dec(lotId):
		dd = decisions.get("%s" % lotId)
		if dd is None:
			dd = decisions.get(lotId)
		dd = BlueRidge.Common.Util.extractQualifiedValues(dd) or {}
		return (dd.get("mode") or "fill"), ("%s" % (dd.get("ltt") or "")).strip()
	overLotIds = set(o.get("lotId") for o in overflow)
	overfillIds = set(o.get("lotId") for o in overflow if _dec(o.get("lotId"))[0] == "overfill")
	batch = [ln for ln in lines if (ln.get("lotId") not in overLotIds) or (ln.get("lotId") in overfillIds)]
	if batch or shotLoss:
		r0 = BlueRidge.Workorder.DieCast.recordShiftOutput({"shiftId": shiftId, "toolId": toolId, "lines": batch, "shotLoss": shotLoss}, appUserId=appUserId, terminalLocationId=term, cellLocationId=cellId)
		BlueRidge.Common.Ui.notifyResult(r0, successTitle="Cavities recorded")
		if not (r0 and r0.get("Status")):
			return
	mintedLotIds = []
	for o in overflow:
		lotId = o.get("lotId")
		mode, ltt = _dec(lotId)
		if mode != "fill":
			continue
		rel = BlueRidge.Lots.Lot.releaseDieCast({"lotId": lotId, "finalPieceDelta": o.get("headroom"), "scrapLines": o.get("scrapLines") or [], "shiftId": shiftId, "appUserId": appUserId, "terminalLocationId": term})
		BlueRidge.Common.Ui.notifyResult(rel, successTitle="Basket " + (o.get("lotName") or "") + " filled + released")
		if not (rel and rel.get("Status")):
			return
		opened = BlueRidge.Lots.Lot.openDieCast({"itemId": o.get("itemId"), "currentLocationId": cellId, "toolId": toolId, "toolCavityId": o.get("toolCavityId"), "lotName": ltt, "appUserId": appUserId, "terminalLocationId": term})
		BlueRidge.Common.Ui.notifyResult(opened, successTitle="New basket " + ltt + " opened")
		if not (opened and opened.get("Status")):
			return
		newLot = opened.get("NewId")
		mintedLotIds.append(newLot)
		rem = BlueRidge.Workorder.DieCast.recordShiftOutput({"shiftId": shiftId, "toolId": toolId, "lines": [{"lotId": newLot, "pieceDelta": o.get("remainder"), "scrapLines": []}], "shotLoss": []}, appUserId=appUserId, terminalLocationId=term, cellLocationId=cellId)
		BlueRidge.Common.Ui.notifyResult(rem, successTitle="Remainder recorded to " + ltt)
		if not (rem and rem.get("Status")):
			return
	if gross:
		BlueRidge.Workorder.DieCast.recordShiftOutput({"shiftId": shiftId, "toolId": toolId, "lines": [], "shotLoss": [], "counterReading": gross}, appUserId=appUserId, terminalLocationId=term, cellLocationId=cellId)
	self._afterSubmit()
	# D9: ONE CRT notice for the whole resolution, not one per basket -- and
	# LAST, after the gross-shots write and _afterSubmit(). Every mint above
	# has already committed, so a raise in this cosmetic read-back would lose
	# the gross-shots production number and leave pendingSubmit populated,
	# pinning the screen in overflow-resolution state.
	BlueRidge.Common.Ui.crtNotice(BlueRidge.Lots.Lot.crtNamesFor(mintedLotIds), len(mintedLotIds))

messageHandlers.script:
# Elevation replay. Read through extractQualifiedValues like every other
	# replay consumer -- the payload arrives as a wrapper, not a plain dict.
	# The DieMount popup subscribes to this same message for its own
	# "mount" / "release" re-assert; a page-scoped send reaches every handler
	# of the name, so each ignores the intents that are not its own.
	p = BlueRidge.Common.Util.extractQualifiedValues(payload) or {}
	if p.get("intent") == "open":
		self.openDieMount()

# One token bump re-reads activeTool, openBasketInstances, shotStatus
	# and cavityOptions together -- a mount or release changes all four.
	# refreshBinding from a message handler fails silently; the token is
	# the mechanism.
	self.view.custom.refreshToken = (self.view.custom.refreshToken or 0) + 1

# An anchor moves the die watermark, so every proposed per-cavity
	# credit on this screen was computed from a floor that no longer
	# applies. Drop the stale breakdown rather than leaving numbers on
	# screen that a submit would no longer produce.
	if payload and payload.get("action") == "anchored":
		self.view.custom.breakdown = []
		self.view.custom.breakdownEntries = {}
		self.recomputeTotals()
		self.view.custom.refreshToken = (self.view.custom.refreshToken or 0) + 1

# Keyed on toolCavityId:lotId -- unique per ROW. toolCavityId alone is
	# not: a cavity whose basket was released earlier this shift keeps a
	# scrap-only row AND gains a second row when a new basket is opened on
	# it, and the two then shared one draft. lotId alone is not either --
	# every basketless cavity carries None.
	if not payload:
		return
	_u = BlueRidge.Common.Util.extractQualifiedValues
	entries = dict(_u(self.view.custom.breakdownEntries) or {})
	cav = "%s" % payload.get("toolCavityId")
	if cav in ("None", ""):
		return
	key = cav + ":" + ("%s" % payload.get("lotId"))
	entries[key] = {
		"good": payload.get("good"),
		"scrapLines": _u(payload.get("scrapLines")) or [],
		"variance": payload.get("variance"),
		"varianceReasonId": payload.get("varianceReasonId"),
		"varianceNote": payload.get("varianceNote") or "",
		"isPending": bool(payload.get("isPending")),
	}
	self.view.custom.breakdownEntries = entries
	self.recomputeTotals()

# A pending cavity carries an Open-basket action inline so the operator can
	# close the gap where they noticed it (spec 6.3). The LTT still has to be
	# scanned, so this routes to Lot Management rather than opening blind.
	p = BlueRidge.Common.Util.extractQualifiedValues(payload) or {}
	self.view.custom.activeTab = 0
	BlueRidge.Common.Notify.toast("Scan the LTT",
		"Scan the ticket for %s on Lot Management, then press OPEN." % (p.get("cavityName") or "this cavity"),
		"info")

# The only channel a repeater row has back to this view: params are
	# input-only, so every keystroke/selection AND every repeater rebuild is
	# reported up here. The fold is the single place that decides what counts
	# as staged, and it can DELETE an entry -- which is how a cavity that has
	# since been opened stops being counted on the button.
	res = BlueRidge.Workorder.DieCast.foldBulkOpenRowChange(self.view.custom.bulkOpenDraft, payload)
	self.view.custom.bulkOpenDraft = res["draft"]
	self.view.custom.bulkOpenPendingCount = res["pending"]

if payload and payload.get("action") == "confirm":
		self.releaseBasket(payload.get("counterReading"), payload.get("finalPieceDelta"), payload.get("scrapLines"))
